# SmartPixel

> SmartPixel is a Chennai-based web design and development agency building conversion-focused websites, ecommerce stores, web applications, mobile apps, SEO solutions and WhatsApp automation for businesses across Chennai, India and international markets.

SmartPixel was founded in 2023 by Aysha and is based in Chrompet, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India. The company works with small and mid-size businesses across Chennai and provides remote services to clients across India and international markets.

SmartPixel has delivered 20+ websites for clients across India and 4+ international markets.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does a SmartPixel website cost?**

Business websites start at ₹15,000. Ecommerce websites start at ₹50,000. Mobile apps start at ₹1,50,000. Final pricing depends on project requirements, functionality, integrations and technical complexity. Every project can begin with a strategy discussion before the final quotation.

**How long does a website build take?**

A standard business website typically takes around 2 weeks. Ecommerce projects typically take around 2–3 weeks. Mobile applications and complex web applications generally require longer development timelines depending on the scope and functionality.

**Does SmartPixel work with businesses outside Chennai?**

Yes. SmartPixel is based in Chrompet, Chennai and works remotely with businesses across India and international markets.

**Does SmartPixel work with international clients?**

Yes. SmartPixel has delivered websites for clients across 4+ international markets and provides remote website development, ecommerce, application development, SEO and automation services.

**What makes SmartPixel different from other web development agencies?**

SmartPixel focuses on building websites and digital systems around business outcomes rather than only visual design. The team combines website development, SEO, AEO, conversion optimisation and automation to create digital platforms designed to generate enquiries and support business growth.

**Does SmartPixel offer SEO services?**

Yes. SmartPixel provides technical SEO, on-page SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile optimisation and search visibility strategies for businesses.

**Does SmartPixel provide local SEO in Chennai?**

Yes. SmartPixel provides local SEO services for businesses targeting Chennai and neighbourhood searches including Chrompet, Tambaram, Pallavaram, Guindy, T Nagar, Saidapet, Nungambakkam and Chitlapakkam.

**Does SmartPixel provide ecommerce development?**

Yes. SmartPixel develops custom ecommerce websites with product catalogues, payment integration, responsive shopping experiences and conversion-focused architecture.

**Does SmartPixel build custom web applications?**

Yes. SmartPixel develops custom web applications, dashboards, SaaS platforms, booking systems, ordering systems and business management tools.

**Does SmartPixel provide WhatsApp automation?**

Yes. SmartPixel develops WhatsApp Business API integrations, automated notifications, chatbots and lead automation systems for businesses.

**Does SmartPixel provide support after website launch?**

Yes. Projects include a post-launch support period, with ongoing maintenance and technical support available for businesses that require continued assistance.
